make_pairs_complete_graph: create image pairs from a list of images using a complete scene graph with symmetrization
make_pairs_swimming_window: create image pairs using a swin-N scene graph that pairs each image with N neighbors
make_pairs_one_reference: create image pairs by pairing a single reference image with all other images in the list
filter_pairs_seq: filter image pairs to keep only those within a specified sequential distance threshold
filter_edges_seq: filter view and prediction tensors by removing edges beyond a sequential frame distance threshold
